title: Household Add-On Membership: relationship proof and dependent documentation required per tier
content:
## Scope
This document states, for each Household Add-On Membership tier, whether documented proof of the relationship is required and which proof types the tier accepts, whether the dependent's own photo identification and a dependent medical clearance form are required on file, and, for the Domestic Partner Add-On specifically, whether documented cohabitation proof is required and the minimum number of months of cohabitation that must be documented.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Proof of relationship required | Accepted proof types | Dependent photo ID required | Dependent medical form required | Cohabitation proof required | Minimum documented cohabitation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spouse Add-On | required | marriage certificate | required | not required | not applicable | 0 months |
| Domestic Partner Add-On | required | domestic-partnership affidavit | required | not required | required | 6 months |
| Dependent Child Add-On | required | birth certificate | not required | not required | not applicable | 0 months |
| Young Adult Add-On | required | birth certificate | required | not required | not applicable | 0 months |
| Senior Parent Add-On | required | birth certificate | required | required | not applicable | 0 months |
| Household Multi-Add-On | required | birth certificate or marriage certificate | not required | not required | not applicable | 0 months |

## Points of judgement
- Every tier of the Household Add-On Membership requires documented proof of the relationship before the dependent may be added; only the accepted proof type or types differ by tier, and only the Household Multi-Add-On accepts either of two proof types rather than exactly one.
- The Domestic Partner Add-On is the only tier that additionally requires documented proof of cohabitation, and it is the only tier that sets a minimum number of months (6) that the cohabitation must already have been documented for.
- The Senior Parent Add-On is the only tier that requires a dependent medical clearance form on file; no other tier requires one.
- A dependent's own photo identification is required on file for the Spouse Add-On, the Domestic Partner Add-On, the Young Adult Add-On and the Senior Parent Add-On, and is not required for the Dependent Child Add-On or the Household Multi-Add-On.
